writeup.headline: Megacaps Turn Higher by Lunch
writeup.summary: This morning's big story was Chip Stocks Roar Back, Morgan Stanley Goes Bullish. The big swing: megacaps slid early, then turned around after 9:40 AM and are now higher on the day — WTOP News points to “US stocks soar and recover more than half of last week’s plunge after Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia”. The AI names are up and the average stock is up: stocks are moving together. Defensive sectors are leading cyclical ones, and the S&P has held its gains all session.

themes.headline: Megacaps climbed back from an early slide
themes.detail: Up 6.6% at 9:40 AM, now +8.6%; biggest gainers since: Nvidia, Meta Platforms. In the news: “US stocks soar and recover more than half of last week’s plunge after Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia” (WTOP News).

themes.headline: S&P has held its gains
themes.detail: Low at 9:40 AM, high at 10:31 AM; +0.3% since the open.

themes.headline: Chip Stocks Roar Back, Morgan Stanley Goes Bullish
